instruction: Could you rename the "workshop_session_3" directory to "workshop_session_4" on the desktop?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires renaming directory from 'workshop_session_3' to 'workshop_session_4'. Evaluator checks if the renamed directory exists using shell command. This variation uses a workshop session numbering pattern.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies both semantic requirements of a rename operation
The shell command checks: (1) target directory 'workshop_session_4' exists via '[ -d ~/Desktop/workshop_session_4 ]'
The shell command checks: (2) source directory 'workshop_session_3' no longer exists via '[ ! -d ~/Desktop/workshop_session_3 ]'
Both conditions are connected with '&&' ensuring both must be true to echo 'Rename successful.'
This prevents false positives from copy operations or directory creation instead of rename
The getter 'get_vm_command_line' can successfully execute the shell command and capture the output
The metric 'exact_match' correctly compares the output against the expected value 'Rename successful.\n'
Coverage is complete: all instruction requirements are verified
